scope: Additional free/legal providers for PaperBooks; research, not new enabled integrations
current_reader: Offline plain text; complete Gutenberg texts and Europe PMC JATS XML. No native PDF/EPUB import yet.
recommendation: Wolne Lektury first. Add a bounded, cached metadata index before integration so searches do not download a multi-megabyte catalogue repeatedly. arXiv is the best later addition for physics, alongside a real PDF/HTML article reader.

candidates.name: Wolne Lektury
candidates.fit: Excellent: public JSON API, direct complete TXT downloads, Polish literature, no account needed for tested endpoints.
candidates.verified_live: Catalogue returned 7660 records / 5110820 bytes. Studnia i wahadlo detail and complete TXT fetched successfully; attribution and licence footer retained.
implementation_requirements: Cache and bound the large catalogue; do not refetch it per query
Resolve details before download and verify actual language, preview flag, TXT URL and book identity
Retain publisher attribution, translators and licence/footer without stripping them

candidates.name: arXiv
candidates.fit: Physics, quantum physics, mathematics and computer science; searchable metadata API and article links.
implementation_requirements: A real PDF/HTML article path; metadata/abstract must never be presented as full text
Follow API terms, request pacing and caching
Preserve licence and author attribution; free reading is not a blanket redistribution licence

candidates.name: OpenStax / OpenStax Poland
candidates.fit: Free academic textbooks, including physics; online reading and free PDF downloads.
implementation_requirements: PDF import/opening rather than flattening formulas and diagrams into plain text
Check the specific book licence and retain attribution; do not assume every title has the same licence

candidates.name: DOAB / OAPEN
candidates.fit: Open-access scholarly books; useful broader academic coverage.
candidates.caution: An official API search page is indexed, but direct retrieval returned 404 and the legacy REST endpoint returned 403 in this environment. Not validated as an immediately usable connector.
implementation_requirements: Confirm the current supported public API with the provider
Resolve actual full-text files and per-book licences

candidates.name: Standard Ebooks
candidates.fit: High-quality public-domain ebook editions, but not a universally anonymous/free OPDS endpoint.
candidates.caution: Official instructions use Patrons Circle authentication. The project documents feed access for qualifying open-source projects; eligibility/approval must be checked, not bypassed.
implementation_requirements: Respect access conditions and applicable copyright jurisdiction

candidates.name: Open Library
candidates.fit: Good discovery metadata, but catalogue presence does not mean unrestricted full-text download.
implementation_requirements: Filter to genuinely accessible public-domain/openly licensed full text
Do not treat lending/login-controlled scans as free downloadable files
Observe documented rate limits and identify the client
